items.title: Ai, Japanese chimpanzee who counted and painted dies at 49
items.title_zh: 会数数、会画画的黑猩猩 Ai 在日本去世，享年 49 岁
items.summary: Ai, a chimpanzee whose cognitive abilities were studied extensively since she was brought to a Japanese institute in 1977, has died at 49.

items.summary: Uncrossy is a puzzle game by Rob Jagnow in which players clear the board by sliding words.

items.title: Network of Scottish X accounts go dark amid Iran blackout

items.summary: A group of Scottish X accounts has gone silent since Thursday, amid widespread protests against the leadership of the Islamic Republic and an internet blackout in Iran.

items.title: Every country should set 16 as the minimum age for social media accounts
items.title_zh: 各国都应将社交媒体最低年龄设为 16 岁
items.summary: The essay argues that every country should set 16 as the minimum age for social media accounts and lays out four features of strong age-limit policies, citing Australia's lead.

items.title: The Gleam Programming Language
items.title_zh: Gleam 编程语言
items.summary: Gleam is presented as a friendly language for scalable, type-safe systems, shipping with a compiler, build tool, formatter, editor integrations and package manager built in.

items.title: JuiceFS is a distributed POSIX file system built on top of Redis and S3
items.title_zh: JuiceFS：基于 Redis 与 S3 构建的分布式 POSIX 文件系统
items.summary: The JuiceFS project provides a distributed POSIX file system whose design builds on Redis and S3, according to its GitHub repository.

items.summary: Dell lists the UltraSharp 52 Thunderbolt Hub Monitor, model U5226KW, on its online store.

items.title: 2025 was the third hottest year on record
items.title_zh: 2025 年是有记录以来第三热的一年
items.summary: The article reports that 2025 was the third hottest year on record.

items.title: Provide agents with automated feedback
items.title_zh: 为智能体提供自动反馈
items.summary: The post argues that the most successful agent projects set up structure around the agent to provide automated feedback on quality and correctness, which lets it work on longer-horizon tasks. It says such back pressure helps agents identify mistakes as they progress and stay aligned to a task for longer.

items.title: Dead Internet Theory
items.title_zh: 死互联网理论
items.summary: A blog post recounts a strange experience that led its author to conclude the internet is probably dead, in a piece titled after the Dead Internet Theory.

items.title: Anthropic made a mistake in cutting off third-party clients
items.title_zh: Anthropic 切断第三方客户端是个错误
items.summary: An opinion piece argues that Anthropic may have made the biggest business blunder of 2026 by cutting off third-party clients, set against the mainstreaming of agentic AI and Andrej Karpathy's “vibe coding” term from February 2025.

items.title: What a year of solar and batteries saved us in 2025
items.title_zh: 2025 年，太阳能和电池究竟替我们省下了多少
items.summary: A homeowner reviews a full year of data on a home solar array and Tesla Powerwall batteries, looking at grid usage and what the setup saved in 2025.

items.title: Photos capture the breathtaking scale of China's wind and solar buildout
items.title_zh: 照片记录中国风电与光伏建设的惊人规模
items.summary: A photo essay documents China's renewable buildout; according to the piece, China installed more than half of all wind and solar capacity added globally last year and in May alone added enough to power Poland, at roughly 100 solar panels per second.

items.title: EmuDevz: A game about developing emulators

items.summary: EmuDevz is a game about developing emulators.

items.summary: A mobile app called Dead or Alive has gone viral on Weibo, drawing widespread attention for its focus on safety for people living alone and sparking debate in China.

items.title: Chinese Neuralink Rival BrainCo Files for Hong Kong IPO, Sources Say
items.title_zh: 中国版 Neuralink 竞争者 BrainCo 秘密递交香港 IPO 申请
items.summary: BrainCo has confidentially filed for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, Bloomberg reported; the company, a Chinese rival to Neuralink, is part of a group known as the "Hangzhou Six."

items.title: Zhipu AI partners with Didi to develop AGI-based mobility agents
items.title_zh: 智谱 AI 与滴滴合作开发基于 AGI 的出行智能体
items.summary: Chinese AI firm Zhipu AI and ride-hailing giant Didi have agreed to a strategic partnership focused on AGI and mobility agents.

items.title: AI-led demand signals longer semiconductor upcycle into 2026 and beyond
items.title_zh: AI 驱动的需求意味着半导体上行周期将延长至 2026 年及以后
items.summary: At the UBS Greater China Conference 2026 in Shanghai, UBS Securities China technology semiconductor analyst Jimmy Yu discussed how AI-led demand points to a longer semiconductor upcycle extending into 2026 and beyond.

items.title: ByteDance’s next-gen AI earphones to be made by Goertek
items.title_zh: 字节跳动下一代 AI 耳机将由歌尔代工
items.summary: ByteDance is working on a next-generation Doubao AI earphone, and Chinese manufacturer Goertek is set to take on its contract manufacturing, according to TechNode.

items.title: Apple expands Apple Pay cross-border payments for mainland China users
items.title_zh: Apple 面向中国大陆用户扩展 Apple Pay 跨境支付
items.summary: Apple announced an expansion on Thursday that extends Apple Pay's cross-border payment offering for mainland China users.

items.title: From lab to living room: how CSOT turns research into reliable displays
items.title_zh: 从实验室到客厅：CSOT 如何把研究变成可靠显示屏
items.summary: The article traces how CSOT brings display research out of the lab and into dependable displays, as displays take on a larger role in consumer electronics and smart devices.

items.title: Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Transsion cut 2026 smartphone shipment forecasts

items.summary: Higher memory prices across the supply chain have led Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo and Transsion to trim their full-year 2026 smartphone shipment forecasts, TechNode reports.

items.summary: A Rust GUI manager for WSL that lets users install, list, start, stop, unregister and configure distributions from a single lightweight dashboard.

items.title: Exploiting DINOv3-Based Self-Supervised Features for Robust Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
items.title_zh: 利用 DINOv3 自监督特征实现稳健的少样本医学图像分割
items.summary: The authors propose DINO-AugSeg, a framework that uses DINOv3 self-supervised features for few-shot medical image segmentation, adding wavelet-based feature augmentation and a context-guided cross-attention fusion module. Experiments on six public benchmarks spanning MRI, CT, ultrasound, endoscopy and dermoscopy showed it consistently outperformed existing methods with limited samples.

items.title: ARC Prize 2025: Technical Report
items.organization: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, Google DeepMind, xAI
items.title_zh: ARC Prize 2025 技术报告
items.summary: The report on the 2025 ARC Prize competition on ARC-AGI-2 says 1,455 teams submitted 15,154 entries, with the top score reaching 24% on the private evaluation set. It highlights per-task refinement loops as the year's defining theme and argues that frontier reasoning is still constrained by knowledge coverage, which encourages new forms of benchmark contamination.

items.title: A New Strategy for Verifying Reach-Avoid Specifications in Neural Feedback Systems
items.title_zh: 神经反馈系统 reach-avoid 规范验证新方法
items.summary: The paper introduces algorithms that compute over- and under-approximations of backward reachable sets for neural feedback systems and integrates them with forward analysis into a unified verification framework for reach-avoid specifications.

items.title: OpenDecoder: Open Large Language Model Decoding to Incorporate Document Quality in RAG
items.title_zh: OpenDecoder：在 RAG 中引入文档质量的开放大模型解码
items.summary: OpenDecoder feeds explicit evaluations of retrieved documents, including relevance, ranking and query performance prediction scores, into LLM generation, and the authors report better robustness and performance than baselines across five benchmark datasets.

items.title: DialDefer: A Framework for Detecting and Mitigating LLM Dialogic Deference
items.title_zh: DialDefer：检测并缓解大模型对话中的顺从偏差
items.summary: The paper documents dialogic deference: LLMs judge the same claim differently when it is framed as a statement to verify rather than attributed to a speaker, with a mean absolute shift of 15.9 percentage points across five models while accuracy moved less than 2 points. It introduces the DialDefer framework and a Dialogic Deference Score, and finds that mitigation can over-correct into skepticism.

items.title: Federated Learning for the Design of Parametric Insurance Indices under Heterogeneous Renewable Production Losses
items.title_zh: 异构可再生能源产量损失下参数化保险指数设计的联邦学习
items.summary: The paper proposes a federated learning framework for calibrating parametric insurance indices when renewable energy producers face heterogeneous production losses, with producers modeling their losses locally using Tweedie generalized linear models. In an experiment with up to 121 solar farms in Germany, federated learning remained valid as the pool grew and was more than 250 times faster than an approximation-based method that became non-computable beyond 50 farms.

items.title: What Trace Powers Reveal About Log-Determinants: Closed-Form Estimators, Certificates, and Failure Modes
items.title_zh: 迹幂揭示的对数行列式：闭式估计、证书与失效模式
items.summary: The paper studies estimating log-determinants of large symmetric positive definite matrices from trace powers, proves that no continuous estimator using finitely many positive moments can be uniformly accurate under unbounded conditioning, and derives provable bounds plus a gap diagnostic at O(m) cost independent of matrix size.
